# The Franklin Craftsman

> Fine wallpaper installation, premium bathroom remodels, and finish carpentry in Williamson County, Tennessee (Franklin, Brentwood, Spring Hill, Thompson's Station, Nolensville, Leiper's Fork) and greater Nashville. Owner-operated by Sean Penner (SRP Renovations LLC) — the same craftsman answers the phone and does the work. One project at a time, one-year workmanship warranty.

## Specialty: Wallpaper Installation

The Franklin Craftsman is one of the few skilled paperhangers serving Franklin and Nashville, TN. Unlike most installers, wall preparation (skim coating, drywall repair, old wallpaper removal) is part of the service — done by a finish carpenter and remodeler by trade.

Papers installed: grasscloth and natural fibers, mural and panel papers (optionally framed in custom molding), hand-printed and block-printed papers, wide-width and commercial vinyls, and peel-and-stick over properly prepared walls. Interior designers welcome: works from designer specs, inspects client-purchased paper, flags quantity and dye-lot issues before install day.

- [Wallpaper Installation — Franklin, Brentwood & Nashville TN](https://franklincraftsman.com/wallpaper.html): services, papers handled, designer program, and FAQ including cost guidance
- [Home](https://franklincraftsman.com/): full services — bathroom remodels, finish carpentry & built-ins, fine wallpaper
